description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between Loss and Training Time for two methods, labeled "Vanilla" and "SepLLM." The x-axis represents "Training Time (s)" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250,000 seconds with tick marks at regular intervals of 50,000. The y-axis represents "Loss" on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.05. The plot contains two solid lines that both demonstrate a steep initial decline followed by a gradual leveling off. The "Vanilla" line is purple with upward-pointing triangle markers; its first clearly visible data point is at approximately 25,000 seconds with a loss of 2.69, and it steadily decreases to end at a loss of exactly 2.50 at approximately 245,000 seconds. The "SepLLM" line is red with circular markers; its first clearly visible data point is at approximately 15,000 seconds with a loss of 2.71, and it decreases to end at a loss of approximately 2.49 at 235,000 seconds. Additionally, the plot features a horizontal dashed green line at a loss value of 2.50. This line intersects the SepLLM curve at approximately 195,000 seconds and the Vanilla curve at approximately 245,000 seconds, with both intersection points denoted by green star markers. Vertical dashed green lines extend downward from these two intersection points, and a horizontal green double-headed arrow labeled "1.26×" spans the distance between them.
